newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 4-wk t-bill gross yield 15.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 4-wk t-bill gross yield 15.8 pct.

text.p: The average gross yield in an auction offering five billion crowns to the market in four-week Czech treasury bills was 15.8 percent on Wednesday, and the auction was oversubscribed, the Czech National bank said.
It said the total nominal amount of bills sold was 10 billion crowns on demand of 11.01 billion crowns, but five billion of that was put into the finance ministry portfolio.
The limit yield on bids was set at 16.0 percent.
The Dutch-style auction meant all accepted bids were at the average of 15.8 percent, with 63.85 percent of bids made at that level accepted.
In the previous auction of four-week t-bills last Thursday, the gross yield was 16.2 percent.
